verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is a proprietary managed edge-compute platform; while the workerd runtime is open-source and a local simulator exists (cloudflare-gh-2), there is no evidence of self-hosting the actual Workers platform (KV, D1, global network, routing) — community comments explicitly note vendor lock-in and lack of portability of the core stack (cloudflare-comm-10, cloudflare-comm-13).
